subject: EU MAP: Stakeholder roundtable & evaluation roadmap — kickoff
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Eva Karlsson <eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com>, Matteo Rossi <matteo.rossi@finproc.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 08:15:00 +0200
Subject: EU MAP: Stakeholder roundtable & evaluation roadmap — kickoff

Hi Eva / Matteo —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to formalize a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on data residency / cross-border controls for your EU deployment and an evaluation plan that lets your infra and security teams validate latency, dataflows, and retention controls before production.

I’m proposing a kick-off roundtable next week to:
- Introduce stakeholders (legal, DPO, procurement, infra)
- Align milestones and gating criteria for the security/compliance checklist
- Walk through the evaluation plan (test dataset, acceptance thresholds, timelines)

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Hannah (compliance lead), Jonas (performance lead), Marcus (deployment/ops). Please let me know if anyone else should join.

Draft MAP attached (MAP_DRAFT_v0.1.pdf) plus a template evaluation plan (Redwood_EvalPlan_Template.xlsx). High level timeline I’d like to align on:
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, stakeholder roster, finalize MAP owners
- Week 1–2: security questionnaire + evidence exchange (SOC2, retention configs)
- Week 3: evaluation window (latency/throughput tests, cross-border simulation)
- Week 4: review & sign-off; plan production cutover by end of month

Can you confirm availability for a 60-minute roundtable on Tuesday 6 Apr or Wednesday 7 Apr (10:00–14:00 CEST window)? Also please confirm the internal contacts who will own legal/DPO/procurement.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v0.1.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_EvalPlan_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Eva Karlsson <eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Matteo Rossi <matteo.rossi@finproc.com>, Lena Svensson <lena.svensson@nordiskabank.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU MAP: Stakeholder roundtable & evaluation roadmap — kickoff

Connor —

Thanks for pulling this together. Tuesday 6 Apr works for us at 11:00 CEST. I’ve looped in our DPO (Lena Svensson) and Matteo (procurement) so we have the legal/controls and procurement owners on the thread.

Quick clarifications:
- For the evaluation plan, we need clarity on whether test traffic will cross into non-EU regions during the load tests — our compliance team requires that simulated traffic stays within EU regions or is explicitly documented if it crosses borders for test reasons.
- We’ll also need a short data retention statement from Redwood for the evaluation window (how long logs / KV cache snapshots are kept and where).

I will confirm procurement timelines after our internal check; 11:00 CEST on the 6th is my tentative acceptance.

Best,
Eva Karlsson
Head of Cloud Platform — Nordiska Bank
eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com

---
Note: Lena Svensson (DPO) may follow up with a couple of targeted items for the questionnaire ahead of the call.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Eva Karlsson <eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU MAP: Stakeholder roundtable & evaluation roadmap — kickoff

On Thu, 1 Apr 2027 at 09:03 +02:00 Eva Karlsson <eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com> wrote:
> Connor —
>
> Thanks for pulling this together. Tuesday 6 Apr works for us at 11:00 CEST. I
> have looped in our DPO (Lena Svensson) and Matteo (procurement) so we
> have the legal/controls and procurement owners on the thread.

Thanks Eva — glad 11:00 CEST on 6 Apr works. I also added Marcus on cc who will own deployment checkpoints and evidence collection.

A couple of follow-ups from the Redwood compliance side to prepare the MAP and reduce friction on the call:
- Roles & owners (we’ll propose owners but please confirm):
  - DPO / data protection owner: Nordiska Bank (Lena Svensson)
  - Procurement & commercial signoff: Nordiska Bank (Matteo Rossi)
  - Security questionnaire and evidence exchange lead: Redwood (Hannah Schmitt)
  - Evaluation lead (latency/throughput): Redwood (Jonas Weber)
  - Deployment / VPC & routing owner: Redwood (Marcus Lin)

- Minimal deliverables pre-call (by Fri 2 Apr):
  - Final stakeholder roster
  - Completed high-level questionnaire (I’ll send a short 12-question checklist by EOD)
  - Drive folder with expected artifacts (SOC2 summary, retention matrices, network diagrams) — link below

- Evaluation plan overview (what we will run during Week 3)
  - Cross-region simulation (explicitly documented; by default we will confine test traffic to EU regions unless the Bank requests an intentional cross-border test)
  - Synthetic load at three percentiles keyed to your expected session concurrency
  - KV cache snapshot verification and retention verification (logs kept for 7 days in the evaluation environment by default; we can shorten on request)
  - Acceptance criteria: latency P95 < 250ms for the test prompt set; no PII leakage in synthetic samples; evidence of retention config in the deployment manifests

I’ve uploaded a working MAP and evaluation template into the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c_MAP-kickoff — Connor, I left placeholder owners in the MAP. Eva / Matteo, if you can confirm DPO/procurement owners and call attendees we’ll finalize the agenda and checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments (linked): Redwood_EvalPlan_Template.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Eva Karlsson <eva.karlsson@nordiskabank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: EU MAP: Stakeholder roundtable & evaluation roadmap — kickoff

Thanks team — I’ll prepare the evaluation harness and a short runbook for the roundtable that outlines:
- Test dataset (anonymized prompts + synthetic PII checks)
- Traffic profile generator and whether traffic stays strictly in EU regions or needs an explicit cross-border toggle (we’ll make the toggle opt-in)
- Expected logs/artifacts and where they’ll be stored (we’ll point to the Drive folder)

Connor — I’ll upload a small performance snapshot and the runbook to the Drive before EOD Mon 5 Apr. Marcus and I will also confirm the deployment playbook (how we pin model variants and simulate quantization profiles).

See you on the 6th at 11:00 CEST.

Jonas Weber
Performance Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

--
Roundtable agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) MAP milestones & owners (10m)
3) Questionnaire & evidence exchange cadence (15m)
4) Evaluation plan walkthrough (20m)
5) Next steps & timelines (5m)

Attachments in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3c_MAP-kickoff
